summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the title escape format entry and Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor (checks is_terminal only, returns bool); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR #2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests were not run and Black was not run, per instructions; added lines were checked manually to be at most 88 characters. No commits were made. The console test skips on any win32 platform rather than only legacy Windows.
